# Claim Review

Use this page for claims that should not be reused externally without verification: time-sensitive facts, market sizes, health claims, legal or policy details, product features, pricing, forecasts, and contradicted statements.

## Review queue

| Status | Domain | Claim type | Review action | Related |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open | health | Wellness market, GLP-1, burnout, health, and longevity claims | Verify against current primary or credible medical/market sources before public use. | [Health, Energy & Readiness](/wiki/health-energy-and-readiness), [Corporate Wellness Opportunity Strategy](/wiki/corporate-wellness-opportunity-strategy) |
| Open | ai-software | Model, API, product, release, and tool-capability claims | Check official docs or current product pages before treating as current. | [AI, Agents & Software Systems](/wiki/ai-agents-and-software-systems) |
| Open | ai-software | Current AI-agent platform claims from May 2026 product-news sources | Verify claims about Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini/Spark, acquisitions, model names, pricing, sharing features, and productivity numbers against primary or current sources before external reuse. | [Agent Execution Systems](/wiki/agent-execution-systems), [Coding Agent Workflows](/wiki/coding-agent-workflows), [Agentic Engineering](/wiki/agentic-engineering), [Agent Skills](/wiki/agent-skills) |
| Open | canada-policy | Law, procurement, policy, program, and defence claims | Check current official sources before publication or business use. | [Canadian Prosperity Agenda](/wiki/canadian-prosperity-agenda), [Sovereignty & Critical Infrastructure](/wiki/sovereignty-and-critical-infrastructure) |
| Open | money | Investing, market-cycle, bubble, and return claims | Treat as thinking material unless independently verified. | [Money, Wealth & Markets](/wiki/money-wealth-and-markets) |
| Open | venture | Revenue, market-size, and creator-method claims | Separate repeatable mechanics from unverified economics. | [Venture Opportunity Discovery](/wiki/venture-opportunity-discovery) |

## Claim labels

- `durable`: principle, mechanism, or personal synthesis unlikely to change quickly.
- `mixed`: useful synthesis with some claims that may age.
- `time-sensitive`: current product, policy, market, legal, health, or price detail.
- `needs-verification`: plausible but not ready for external use.
- `external-use ready`: verified against current reliable sources.
